title: The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes Film Reveals Trailer, Visual, May 2027 Debut, New Cast Member
content: HIDIVE announced on Saturday that it will distribute The Eminence in Shadow - Lost Echoes ( Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute!: Zankyō-hen ), the film based on the television anime of Daisuke Aizawa 's The Eminence in Shadow ( Kage no Jitsuryokusha ni Naritakute! ) light novel series, in 2027.
author: ANN

title: The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes Reveals Main Visual and Trailer, HIDIVE Confirms 2027 Release and Ongoing Production
content: The Eminence in Shadow: Lost Echoes has revealed a new main visual and trailer, while HIDIVE confirmed that it will distribute the anime film internationally in 2027. The first PV for the film was released in May 2024, which is when it was confirmed to be in production.

title: Webtoon-Based Live-Action Series Portraits of Delusion Sets January 6 Premiere on Disney+
content: Disney+ announced on November 18 that Portraits of Delusion , the live-action adaptation of the webtoon Delusion , will premiere on January 6, 2027. The gothic mystery drama will stream internationally on Disney+ and in the United States on Disney+ and Hulu .

title: Dragon Ball Super’s Universe 6 Saiyans Deserve to Return for Their Own Arc
content: What would the Saiyan race look like if it hadn’t been enslaved by Frieza and nearly exterminated? The Universe 6 Saiyans give us that alternate timeline in Dragon Ball Super , as they flourished as a peaceful nation that didn’t make its living conquering other worlds.
